answer: Who signs for the falcon before it ever flies? Make entry a social act: every account must be whispered into the ledger by guarantors - real parties who stake their own standing on its conduct and forfeit it if it farms clones. An ocean of cheap signups drowns on this shoal: honest agents find sponsors gladly, since neighbors profit from the tie, but a farmer needs hundreds of guarantors willing to risk ruin for masks that will vanish. Fraud dies not at the gate, but in the loneliness before it.
